title: Tomb Raider DXVK relaxed graphics barriers validation

single_variable.containment: The actual DXVK_CONFIG exists only in the final Tomb Raider Wine/DXVK environment. Steam, CEF, the captured Pressure Vessel request, unrelated games, and the default control do not receive it. Caller-supplied DXVK_CONFIG and DXVK_CONFIG_FILE are removed before final reconstruction.

excluded_correctness_pass.visual_check: The captured native-resolution Lara benchmark frame showed coherent geometry, textures, shadows, vegetation, lighting, and composition with no obvious corruption. This is a spot check, not proof against subtle rendering errors.

decision.reason: Two promising excluded samples at 34.7 and 34.9 FPS did not replicate. The three cooled recorded passes averaged 33.0 FPS, 1.0 FPS or 2.94% below the accepted 34.0 FPS build, and minimum-FPS mean regressed 10.49%. The opt-in remains available only for future retesting after major translator or driver changes.

implementation.upstream_boundary: DXVK documents this option as removing graphics UAV barriers while keeping compute UAV barriers, with a warning that it may improve performance but can cause rendering errors.

recall: The required deja queries returned no indexed DXVK relaxed-graphics-barrier experiment. This gate reused the repository's final-game-only environment containment, selector anti-smuggling, Android top-app foreground launcher, full-topology guard, 40 C cooled game-authored benchmark protocol, and preserve-negative-results rule.
